=== HYPOTHESIS ===
# p_1234 — Dog feeding anchors the kitchen; the toy follows the dog

The dog is fed at exactly 7:30 and 18:00, and the dog_food_bag is brought from the pantry to the counter only for those two feedings. The dog_toy is on floor_l_l1 during play windows (8:00–9:00 and 19:30–21:00) but is picked up and stored on the bookshelf_l1 at other times. The dog_bowl stays on floor_k_k1 permanently (it is never put away). Elena handles the 7:30 feeding on weekdays; Priya handles it on weekends. What sets this apart: the dog_toy is NOT on the floor at midday—it is on the bookshelf. The dog_food_bag is at the counter only in narrow windows. What would refute it: the dog_toy found on floor_l_l1 at 14:00, or the dog_food_bag on the counter at 10:00.
